Free camping (9-day limit) but a NMDGF GAIN permit is required; first-come, first-served. --Claude

No RVs/trailers over 30 ft on Santa Cruz Lake Rd (tight turns, washboard dirt entrance); rigs to ~26-28 ft reported navigating in. --Claude

The separate lower in-canyon Mills Canyon Campground is NOT for RVs/trailers. --Claude
